headline: BUNKER HILL + SILVER47 CLOSE — 388 Moz AgEq U.S. Silver Portfolio Assembled; Commercial Production by Year-End
snippet: Bunker Hill Mining completed its merger with Silver47 Exploration on November 6, issuing 36.3 million shares to Silver47 shareholders under a BC court-approved plan of arrangement, assembling a 'Made in America' silver producer across four U.S. projects with 80 Moz AgEq measured and indicated and 308 Moz AgEq inferred. Bunker Hill remains on track for commercial production at its Idaho Silver Valley mine by end of Q4 2026.

headline: GOLDMAN: BUY NEWMONT, CAUTION ON EVOLUTION — Broker Rates ASX Gold Stocks After Post-Election Surge; Copper Risk Flagged
snippet: Goldman Sachs updated its ASX gold stock coverage following the post-election rally, rating Newmont a Buy on attractive valuation and strong cost execution while assigning Evolution Mining a Neutral — flagging elevated downside risk if copper by-product prices soften. The note landed as the ASX gold sector index surged more than 12% in a single session on gold crossing US$4,100.

headline: COPPER FALLS TO 2.5-MONTH LOW — $13,786/t as Democrat Sweep Dims U.S. Tariff and AI Infrastructure Demand Story
snippet: LME copper slid to approximately US$13,786 per tonne on November 6 — its lowest level since mid-August — as markets reassessed the outlook for U.S. AI-infrastructure copper demand following the Democratic midterm sweep. TD Securities noted that aggressive copper tariffs under Republican leadership had been a key bullish swing factor, and those prospects faded with the election result.

headline: ENERGY FUELS Q3: 320K LBS URANIUM AT $88.90/LB — 63% Gross Margin as Mill Pauses; Non-Cash Loss Widens Deficit
snippet: Energy Fuels (NYSE: UUUU) reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$29.18 million on sales of 320,000 pounds of U3O8 at a realized price of US$88.90 per pound, achieving a 63% uranium gross margin and a third consecutive profitable uranium segment quarter. The net loss widened to US$52.2 million due to US$35.3 million in non-cash unrealized securities losses, while mining produced 385,000 pounds in Q3 with the mill paused for scheduled maintenance.

headline: RUSSIA CONTROLS 44% OF GLOBAL URANIUM ENRICHMENT — New Report Warns Western Nuclear Programs Far More Exposed Than Mine Data Suggests
snippet: A new analysis warns that Russia's strategic grip on uranium is far deeper than production figures imply — Moscow controls roughly 44% of global enrichment capacity, per U.S. Department of Energy data — giving it asymmetric leverage over Western nuclear programs that cannot be offset by increased mine output from Canada, Kazakhstan, or Australia without massive downstream processing investment.

headline: EAGLE NUCLEAR GRABS NOBLE PLAINS WYOMING URANIUM — All-Stock ISR Deal as Long-Term Uranium Hits US$98/lb
snippet: Eagle Nuclear Energy signed a binding letter of intent to acquire Noble Plains Uranium in an all-stock deal, adding the Shirley Central in-situ recovery project in Wyoming's Shirley basin as the Cameco long-term uranium price indicator reached US$98.00 per pound — the highest level since the late-1970s uranium boom. The deal increases Eagle's scale in domestic U.S. uranium supply as geopolitical competition for enrichment capacity intensifies.

headline: GOLD-SILVER RATIO EXPANDS TO HIGH 70s — Silver Technically Oversold Near Historic Support; GoldSeek Sees Reversal Setup
snippet: The gold-to-silver ratio climbed into the high 70s as silver lagged gold's recovery from one-year lows, with one GoldSeek analyst identifying major technical support at the 49.56 level and flagging silver as significantly oversold after six straight weekly declines. With gold now above US$4,100 post-election and silver still near US$52, the case for silver catch-up is building — but the ratio's expansion warns that catch-up has not yet begun.

headline: RADISSON MINING 83% THROUGH O'BRIEN STEP-OUT — High-Grade Gold Extends Beneath Historic Abitibi Mine on 140,000m Program
snippet: Radisson Mining (TSXV: RDS) released fresh results from its 140,000-metre step-out program at the former O'Brien gold mine in Abitibi, Quebec, confirming high-grade gold mineralization continues both beneath and adjacent to the historic mine — with 83% of all program holes now complete. O'Brien sits in one of Canada's highest-grade gold corridors and the step-out scale underscores management's conviction that the system is significantly larger than previously defined.

headline: TECK MEGA-MERGER ON FINAL HURDLE — $53B Anglo American All-Stock Deal Awaits Only China Antitrust Sign-Off
snippet: Anglo American's US$53 billion all-stock merger with Teck Resources cleared all jurisdictions except China's State Administration for Market Regulation, with completion now expected by March 2027. Anglo American shares rallied alongside FTSE 100 mining peers on November 6 as the approaching close reinforces the view that the combined entity would rank among the world's top five copper producers.

headline: GOLD MINERS STILL CHEAP AT $4,100 GOLD — Opinion: Election Surge Opened Best Entry Window Since 2024; Balance Sheets 'Fortress-Level'
snippet: An analysis argues that despite the 8–10% single-day surge in gold producers following the Democratic midterm sweep, gold mining stocks remain materially undervalued relative to spot gold, with major producers carrying fortress-level balance sheets and near-decade-low net debt ratios — presenting a buy-the-momentum case for investors who missed the initial move but are still positioned ahead of the next leg.
